label: ONE_OVER_LIKENESS_2: LikenessFormation supplies a common Form of the designated likeness quality q…
definition: LikenessFormation supplies a common Form of the designated likeness quality q for every eligible genuine mutually resembling plurality. It is an open universal reconstruction of Parmenides132e–133a, with q held fixed through iteration.
note: Explicit semantic boundary for issue #258. The cited primary readings motivate research premises without defining this modern finite-list encoding. A sourced replacement would need to settle precisely these quantifiers, domains and predication senses.
